package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner;

import java.time.LocalDate;

import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;

/**
 * Runs in the create-owner pipeline after {@link BuildOwner}. Resolves the effective registration
 * date — the value supplied in the request, or the server's current date when the request omitted
 * one — and adjusts it to a business day via {@link BusinessDays}: a Saturday or Sunday rolls
 * forward to the next Monday. The adjusted date is stored on the built owner in place, so later
 * steps derive from and respond with the resolved business-day value (formatted as ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD').
 */
public class DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate {

    public void service(@Val Owner owner) {
        LocalDate effective = owner.getRegistrationDate() != null
                ? owner.getRegistrationDate()
                : LocalDate.now();
        owner.setRegistrationDate(BusinessDays.adjust(effective));
    }
}

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored in E.164 form; a leading
            '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed
            and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+()\-\s]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode

            digits and fall within the owner's city's region range (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date. The
            effective date must fall on a business day, so a Saturday or Sunday (whether supplied
            or defaulted) is rolled forward to the next Monday before it is stored.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Write-only create directive. When true, permits creating this owner even
            though another owner already has the same lastName and address (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace); otherwise such a request is rejected.
          type: boolean

    Owner:

        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.

              format: int32

              example: 1

            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.

            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier assigned to owners that deliberately share a
                household (same lastName and address, created with sharesHousehold true). Owners in
                the same household carry the same value; owners with a unique household have none.
              type: string
              example: 3f2504e0-4f89-31e3-9d64-fb1a2f9c1e11
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007-M26

            membershipLevel:

              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 derived at read time.
                Starts at 1; add 1 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; capped
                at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:

              description: The owner's region, derived at read time. The postcode is preferred - a
                4-digit postcode in a known region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099) yields that region, disambiguating cities that share a name. When the
                postcode is absent or in no known range it falls back to the pinned city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true

              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true

                identityKey equals an existing owner's is rejected with 409. Two members of the same
                household with different telephones have different identityKeys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3f2504e0-4f89-31e3-9d64-fb1a2f9c1e11'
              readOnly: true

                registration business day at the moment it was created; otherwise false. Evaluated
                and fixed at creation.
              type: boolean

        firstName:
          title: First name

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored in E.164 form; a leading
            '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed
            and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+()\-\s]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and fall within the owner's city's region range (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present
            it drives the derived ageBand, computed against the owner's registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

            effective date must fall on a business day, so a Saturday or Sunday (whether supplied
            or defaulted) is rolled forward to the next Monday before it is stored.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'

          title: Shares household
          description: Write-only create directive. When true, permits creating this owner even
            though another owner already has the same lastName and address (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace); otherwise such a request is rejected.

              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.

              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string

              example: 4

              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier assigned to owners that deliberately share a
                household (same lastName and address, created with sharesHousehold true). Owners in

              type: string
              example: 3f2504e0-4f89-31e3-9d64-fb1a2f9c1e11
              readOnly: true

              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 derived at read time.

                at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, derived at read time. The postcode is preferred - a
                4-digit postcode in a known region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099) yields that region, disambiguating cities that share a name. When the
                postcode is absent or in no known range it falls back to the pinned city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time. 'EMAIL' when
                an email is present; otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived duplicate-detection key,
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId empty when absent).
                All duplicate detection is expressed through this one key; a create whose whole
                identityKey equals an existing owner's is rejected with 409. Two members of the same
                household with different telephones have different identityKeys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3f2504e0-4f89-31e3-9d64-fb1a2f9c1e11'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration business day at the moment it was created; otherwise false. Evaluated

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true

              items:

              readOnly: true
          required:
